page.layout: One column of italic Latin verse, centred on the page, with the catchword at lower right and the page number and signature at the foot.

l.i: Quos ore profert, nec supinus auditor
Credes? at immo credere istud hinc ausis
In secla ituras illinens stilus chartas,
Vinci nisi ore Witsii nequit solo;
Mecum putaris, pectus illud, os illud
Nam plura nunquam videris simul monstra,
Absolvere omnes ex decore sic scenas.
Eniti in altum: duplicis quod est Agri
Nimiique lyncis, loco foco his procul sacris
Dies in auro fulgeat: nec aprica
Ingens in aevum mergitur: sacrique ipse

page.notes: Verse text in italic; the large swash initials of Quos, Quastorque, Quis and Qua are read as Q. Several words are faint or specked at the edges of the scan, notably "Quastorque", "Exesse", "lentatis" and "Exarmat"; these are copied as they appear but may be unreliable. The foot signature is partly unclear and marked [?]. The running head is absent. Specks in the margins are not printed text.
